methods.note: Moved from Boat#checkInWater (1.21.1) when AbstractBoat was introduced; the 1.21.2 AbstractBoat body is textually identical to the 1.21.1 Boat body (same bounds, waterLevel reset, FluidState height test)

Locals renamed (lv->sound, lv2->viewVector, d/e->dx/dz, list->entities, bl->addNewPassengers, lv3->entity), playSound call re-wrapped, and lv3.getType().is(tag) became entity.is(tag); 26.1 Entity implements TypedInstance whose is(TagKey) is typeHolder().is(tag) with typeHolder() = type.builtInRegistryHolder(), the same holder 1.21.11 EntityType#is(TagKey) used
Moved from Boat#tickBubbleColumn (1.21.1); the 1.21.2 AbstractBoat body is textually identical (same 0.05/0.1 multiplier, -0.7 / 2.7 / 0.6 impulses)
level().isClientSide field read became level().isClientSide(), which in 1.21.9 Level simply returns the isClientSide field

The forward-input float parameter h was replaced by the ridden-input Vec3 whose z is the same forward value (built as new Vec3(f,0,g) by getRiddenInput and passed by tickRidden), so h>0.0F became arg.z>0.0 on the widened float, the same sign test; locals i/j renamed g/h, arithmetic identical

Level.getRelativeFloorHeight(pos) (1.16.1, predicate always false) became BlockGetter.getBlockFloorHeight(pos) (1.16.2): both take the block's collision-shape max Y if non-empty, else the block below's max Y minus 1 when >=1, else -inf; DismountHelper.isFloorValid became isBlockFloorValid with the identical body !isInfinite(d) && d<1.0
level field reads became the level() accessor, which returns the same field
Parameter type narrowed from LivingEntity to Player and onGround field became onGround() accessor returning that field; body otherwise identical
Only the parameter type changed (LivingEntity to Player); body identical
Rename of the LivingEntity override target onLadder (1.15.2) to onClimbable (1.16); the AbstractHorse override body is identical (return false)
Removed only because LivingEntity#onLadder was renamed onClimbable in 1.16; AbstractHorse#onClimbable (1.16) has the identical body return false
Chained assignments yRotO = yRot = lv.yRot and yHeadRot = yBodyRot = yRot were split into sequential assignments with the same values in the same order; nothing else changed

playSound(SoundEvents.HORSE_JUMP,0.4F,1.0F) became playJumpSound(), whose 1.13.2 AbstractHorse body is that same call (SkeletonHorse overrides it with another sound); sound only, no physics state changes

Inline jump boost (d + (amp+1)*0.1F if JUMP effect else d) became d + getJumpBoostPower(); 1.17.1 LivingEntity#getJumpBoostPower returns 0.1F*(amp+1) (same float product, widened) or 0.0, and d>0 here so d+0.0==d; same value
Empty body; only a ServerLevel parameter was added
rider != null became isVehicle() (non-empty passenger list) as the single rider field became the passenger list; same condition
move(x,y,z) became move(MoverType.SELF,x,y,z); in 1.11.2 Entity#move the type only matters for the PISTON clamp and the sneak-edge check, which SELF passes exactly like the 1.10.2 unconditional check
onGround field reads became onGround() accessor returning that field
Visibility changed from private to public; body identical
GameEvent.ENTITY_DAMAGED was renamed ENTITY_DAMAGE in 1.19 (same game event for a damaged entity); non-physics, nothing else changed
level field became level() accessor
arg.x/this.x field reads became getX()/getZ() accessors returning the same position
level field became level() accessor
level().isClientSide field read became isClientSide(), which in 1.21.9 Level returns that field

The inline gravity (if !noGravity add (0, inWater ? -0.005 : -0.04, 0)) became applyGravity(); 1.20.5 Entity#applyGravity adds (0,-getGravity(),0) when non-zero, getGravity() is noGravity ? 0 : getDefaultGravity(), and AbstractMinecart#getDefaultGravity is inWater ? 0.005 : 0.04 (no minecart subclass overrides it); the rotation block only renames locals

getEntitiesIn (1.8.8: getEntities with NO_SPECTATORS) plus an inline instanceof AbstractMinecart && type RIDEABLE test became getEntities with the RIDABLE_MINECARTS predicate (1.9.4: exactly that instanceof/type test); minecarts are never spectators, the filtered list keeps the same order, distance test unchanged, the list null check was dead
level field became level() accessor
Indexed loop over the returned list became a for-each over the same list, same order
Moved to AbstractBoat#floatBoat (1.21.2) whose body is identical apart from Boat.Status constants becoming AbstractBoat.Status constants (same five enum values in the same order)
PooledMutableBlockPos in a try-with-resources became a plain MutableBlockPos; same positions and loop
level field became level() accessor
Moved to AbstractBoat#getGroundFriction (1.21.2), whose body is textually identical
Moved to AbstractBoat#getStatus (1.21.2); identical except Boat.Status became AbstractBoat.Status (same constants)
Boat.method_11330 (1.10.2) moved to LiquidBlock.method_13710 (1.11.2) with identical body pos.getY() + method_13709(...), itself identical to method_11326
PooledMutableBlockPos try-with-resources became a plain MutableBlockPos; same loops
level field became level() accessor
Moved to AbstractBoat#isUnderwater (1.21.2); identical except Boat.Status became AbstractBoat.Status (same constants)

Moved to AbstractBoat#push (1.21.2); identical except instanceof Boat became instanceof AbstractBoat, and the set of boat entities is the same (1.21.1: Boat and ChestBoat extends Boat; 1.21.2: Boat, ChestBoat, Raft, ChestRaft all extend AbstractBoat, rafts being the former bamboo Boat type)

move(x,y,z) became move(MoverType.SELF,x,y,z); in 1.11.2 Entity#move SELF only differs from other types in the PISTON clamp and the sneak-edge check, which it passes like the 1.10.2 unconditional check
Velocity fields became getDeltaMovement()/setDeltaMovement(Vec3.ZERO) with the same values, and width fields became getBbWidth() (the 1.14.4 dimensions width)

The removed this.xo/yo/zo = x/y/z stores were dead: in 1.14.4 they are immediately followed by super.tick() -> Entity#tick -> baseTick, which sets xo/yo/zo from x/y/z again with no position change in between; playSound position uses getX()/getY()/getZ() accessors
(float)(paddle + (float)(PI/8)) became paddle + (float)(PI/8); float+float is already float, the cast was a decompiler artefact
level field became level() accessor
Indexed loop over the entity list became a for-each over the same list, same order
velocityY -= 0.7 became setDeltaMovement(v.add(0,-0.7,0)) and velocityY = (player ? 2.7 : 0.6) became setDeltaMovement(v.x, same, v.z); same values
hasPassenger(Player.class) (1.16.5: any passenger whose class isAssignableFrom Player) became hasPassenger(e -> e instanceof Player); same test
level field became level() accessor
Moved to AbstractBoat#tickBubbleColumn (1.21.2), whose body is textually identical
itemEntity.remove() became discard(); for ItemEntity (no override) 1.16.5 remove() sets removed=true and 1.17 discard() is remove(DISCARDED), which marks it removed without a KILLED game event
Cast to WorldlyContainer became an instanceof pattern variable and loop variable k renamed i; same logic
Parameter and local renames plus final modifiers only (bl->changed, lv->copy, lv2->result, arg3->itemStack, etc.); expressions identical
Indexed loop over the int[] slots became an enhanced for over the same array; locals renamed

The empty check plus explicit loops over getSlotsForFace / 0..size became getSlots(c,dir).anyMatch(slot -> tryTakeInItemFromSlot(...)); 1.14.4 getSlots is IntStream.of(getSlotsForFace) for WorldlyContainer else IntStream.range(0,size), anyMatch short-circuits in the same order, and the item-entity loop is reached only when there is no source container, as before

The Level is now passed explicitly and given to getSourceContainer/getItemsAtAndAbove where 1.16.5 used hopper.getLevel(); the 1.17 helpers are otherwise the same (getContainerAt's block.isEntityBlock() became state.hasBlockEntity(), both instanceof EntityBlock), and MinecartHopper passes its own level
Only an unused ServerLevel parameter was added; body identical
Only an unused ServerLevel parameter was added; body identical
new BlockPos(this) (1.15.2: floor of getX/getY/getZ) became blockPosition(), the 1.16 cached BlockPos kept equal to the floored position by setPosRaw
level field became level() accessor
level().isClientSide field read became isClientSide(), which returns that field
Return type void became boolean returning super.causeFallDamage(f,g); the explosion and the super call are unchanged
A DamageSource parameter was added and only forwarded to super.causeFallDamage; the explosion logic is unchanged
x/y/z fields became getX()/getY()/getZ() accessors
remove() became discard(); MinecartTNT has no remove override, and discard() is remove(DISCARDED), which removes the entity without a KILLED game event
level field became level() accessor
The removed explode(double) overload only delegated to explode(null, d); the remaining explode(DamageSource,double) body is unchanged
getGameRules().getBoolean(RULE_TNT_EXPLODES) became getGameRules().get(TNT_EXPLODES), the same boolean rule (default true in both) under the 1.21.11 game-rule API
Parameter and local renames plus final modifiers only (arg->damageSource, d->speedSqr, e->speed, lv->level); expressions identical
ParticleType.SMOKE became ParticleTypes.SMOKE (particle registry rename); particle only, nothing else changed
velocityX*velocityX + velocityZ*velocityZ became getHorizontalDistanceSqr(getDeltaMovement()), which in 1.14.4 is x*x + z*z
Particle position uses getX()/getY()/getZ() accessors; particle only
Entity.getHorizontalDistanceSqr(v) became v.horizontalDistanceSqr(), which in 1.17 Vec3 is x*x + z*z
level field became level() accessor in the particle call
pos.getBottomCenter() and pos.getCenter() became Vec3.atBottomCenterOf(pos) and Vec3.atCenterOf(pos); the 26.1.2 BlockPos methods are exactly those calls

activateMinecart gains the ServerLevel argument, which is the level the method already runs on; Minecart/MinecartHopper/MinecartTNT/AbstractMinecart ignore it and MinecartCommandBlock uses it where 1.21.10 used this.level()
pos.getBottomCenter() became Vec3.atBottomCenterOf(pos), which is what the 26.1.2 BlockPos#getBottomCenter returns
Moved from AbstractMinecart#getPos (1.21.1) with an identical body except exits(...) qualified as AbstractMinecart.exits(...) and level() now MinecartBehavior#level() = minecart.level()
activateMinecart gains the ServerLevel argument lv, which is this.level() cast; Minecart/MinecartHopper/MinecartTNT ignore it and MinecartCommandBlock uses it where 1.21.10 used this.level()
